description: Universal Bokahli reasoning capability. Byte-identical for all three agents. Adapter only: Bokahli is external and is never modified from here.
invariants: the requested model and the served model are recorded separately
every run records why its route was chosen; a run with no reason is a default in disguise
fallback must be explicitly authorized and recorded; an unauthorized substitution is SILENT_FALLBACK and blocks completion
an unobservable served model is UNKNOWN, never OK
unavailability is reported honestly as UNAVAILABLE
the caller may not select an unrestricted model or tool
route qualification is separate from agent identity, role assignment and toolkit version

routePolicy.statement: There is no mandatory default route. An agent is not a model: the route is chosen per task from demonstrated qualification, task type, risk, context requirements, tool-use and structured-output reliability, evidence quality, availability, latency, cost and operator policy. Local routes are optional, not required.
routePolicy.authority: The work order states required capabilities, risk, budget policy and whether local/cloud use is allowed. It does not normally name a model.
